dssat_weatherMan_guidance.source: DSSAT.net FAQ: How to generate daily weather data
dssat_weatherMan_guidance.meaning: Nominal record-length guidance only; it does not waive variable completeness or provenance requirements.

option_A.source_consistency: ChinaFLUX 30-minute series plus explicitly flagged legacy daily observations on missing-interval dates; not ChinaFLUX-only after fallback.
option_A.reason: Temperature field-to-height mapping remains unresolved; any residual rain gaps also block parameter fitting. Seven nominal years cannot override these gates.

option_B.source_consistency: Not met; the last three years rely on legacy sources and contain pre-fill SRAD/temperature or date gaps.
option_B.reason: 2011-2013 lack a comparable, complete weather source and some variables were monthly-mean imputed; temperature mapping for ChinaFLUX remains unresolved.

final_decision: No final fitting window approved and no CLI generated.
